cells.gaps: No cohort of startups has been taken in: the new incubator's applications were open in August 2026. A World Bank document of October 2026 says there are no hubs, against the hubs found.
cells.note: Rebuild 2026-11-13: the BTI incubator was launched with applications open for its 2026 cohort (SYC-001), an intake not yet made, read as Niger's is, so 3 to 2. The UniSey Centre for Innovation is open (SYC-003), so the World Bank's no-hubs statement (SYC-004) does not set 1.
